verdict.rationale: The pack has no evidence of token-by-token streaming. It does show some documented latency levers: Predicted Outputs "optimizes response time", prompt-cache hits "can reduce response latency", and Priority Tier queues requests ahead of Standard traffic under high load. Community reports describe answers in about 1s versus 5-8s for other models, though the speed advantage does not hold for web-search queries. Missing for 10: documented streaming/SSE support, published latency figures or time-to-first-token behavior, and corroboration that answers are reliably sub-second.
